# Community Health Programme Review

## Introduction

This report reviews the community health programme delivered between 2023 and 2025. It explains what was done, how it was measured, and what the results suggest for the next planning cycle.

## Methodology

We interviewed forty-two participants and reviewed clinic records for the same period. Interviews followed a fixed guide, and every record was checked by two reviewers.

## Research Questions

What factors are associated with clinic attendance?

How do travel distance and cost affect attendance?

## Findings

Attendance rose in every district. The largest gains came where transport support was offered. Participants said that cost, not distance, was the main barrier before the programme began.

## Conclusion

The programme improved attendance, and the evidence points to transport support as the most useful change. We recommend keeping it in the next cycle.
